critical_chain: v1.0.23 measured egress and no-reload-without-proof concept
v1.0.44 global fail-closed Avito network request authority
known_history_gaps_preserved: exact package v1.0.6 unresolved due historical SHA conflict
v1.0.2-v1.0.5 and v1.0.20-v1.0.21 have limited version-specific authority

new_root_cause.summary: v1.0.44 correctly forbids a fresh Avito request when egress did not change, but the inherited recovery escalation still depends on an Avito retry to trigger the next recovery attempt. Therefore attempt 2 provider rotation and attempt 3 endpoint creation become unreachable after a fail-closed attempt 1.
source_proof: prepareRecoveryProxy only dispatches provider change_ip_link when record.attempt >= 2
maybeCreateRecoveryEndpoint returns without create when record.attempt < 3
v1.0.44 attempt 1 with same measured IP terminates before any Avito request and reports back to chat
new_root_cause.why_v144_exposed_it: The new global request authority removed the unsafe target retry that previously advanced the state machine indirectly. The safe gate revealed that recovery transport escalation was not self-contained.

required_invariant_v145.attempt_2: provider rotation when supported, then probe
required_invariant_v145.attempt_3: endpoint create/reconcile when authorized and needed, then probe
required_invariant_v145.attempt_4: bounded final transport recovery/probe only; no infinite loop
required_invariant_v145.success_gate: Only PROBES_COMPLETE with probe_before != probe_after may authorize one controlled Avito request
required_invariant_v145.failure_gate: If all bounded transport attempts fail to prove new egress, terminate with exact reason and preserved cursor/state
required_invariant_v145.provider_mutation_rule: No blind duplicate provider mutation after unknown outcome; per-attempt durable reservation remains authoritative

red_required_before_runtime_change: exact v1.0.44: same-IP attempt 1 returns terminal before attempt 2 provider rotation can run
exact v1.0.44: same-IP attempt 1 returns terminal before attempt 3 endpoint create can run
